Item Class: Tablet
Rarity: Rare
Cyclopean Myth
Abyss Tablet
--------
Item Level: 80
--------
{ Implicit Modifier }
Adds Abysses to a Map
10 uses remaining
--------
{ Prefix Modifier "Abounding" (Tier: 1) }
Map has 18(15-20)% increased Monster Rarity
{ Prefix Modifier "Bountiful" (Tier: 1) }
32(25-35)% increased Gold found in Map
{ Suffix Modifier "of Ossification" (Tier: 1) }
25(20-30)% increased chance for Desecrated Currency from Abysses in Map
{ Suffix Modifier "of Schisms" (Tier: 1) }
Map has 34(20-40)% chance to contain four additional Abysses
--------
Can be used in a personal Map Device to add modifiers to a Map.
